t: 奥地利,普鲁士,和俄罗斯的代表签署三项双边公约,谴责波兰-立陶宛联邦的"无政府主义",并将"古…
te: The representatives of Austria, Prussia, and Russia sign three bilateral conventions condemning the "anarchy" of the Po…
dz: 第一次瓜分波兰:奥地利,普鲁士,和俄罗斯的代表签署三项双边公约,谴责波兰-立陶宛联邦的"无政府主义",并将"古有合法权利"三权归于联邦领土. 这些公约允许三个大国中的每一个都吞并英联邦的一部分,它们在接下来的两个月中继续这样做.
de: First Partition of Poland: The representatives of Austria, Prussia, and Russia sign three bilateral conventions condemning the "anarchy" of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and imputing to the three powers "ancient and legitimate rights" to the territories of the Commonwealth. The conventions allow each of the three great powers to annex a part of the Commonwealth, which they proceed to do over the course of the following two months.

de: Gustav III of Sweden stages a coup d'état, in which he assumes power and enacts a new constitution that divides power between the Riksdag and the King.

de: King Gustav III completes his coup d'état by adopting a new Constitution, ending half a century of parliamentary rule in Sweden and installing himself as an enlightened despot.
